scripts/skill_system_deps.sh

Shell · Tier B

Install native prerequisites for the full skill dependency profile.

Usage

Source from shared or platform installers after package-manager bootstrap.

Inputs

Existing system-dependency skip flags and selected macOS package manager.

Side effects

Installs native packages through the configured OS repositories.

Cleanup

Optional package failures are reported and setup continues; no rollback or explicit service restart.
